investment_theses.thesis: Long USD and short EUR on French eurozone contagion risk; divergence widens if Macron's government faces no-confidence votes or debt restructuring begins.
supporting_signals: CNBC: French borrowing costs surge; political and debt risks mount; eurozone contagion concern explicit
Historical parallel: 2011–2012 European sovereign debt crisis; periphery spreads widened before ECB intervened
investment_theses.counter_view: ECB will backstop French debt quickly; euro strength from risk-off USD flows; Macron retains supermajority or forms coalition in next elections.
investment_theses.expression: Long DXY (U.S. Dollar Index ETF) or short EUR/USD (FX pair via spot or futures); hedge with short duration European sovereign bonds or long OAS spreads (France vs. Germany Bunds)
